summary: ISponsorBlockTV is a command‑line client that contacts the SponsorBlock API and inserts skip markers into YouTube TV playlists, enabling ad‑skipping across TV clients. It runs locally as a Python package (v2.11.0) and requires no API key. The tool is suited for power users who manage YouTube TV setups and want a lightweight, open‑source ad‑skipping solution. It stands out with a large GitHub following (6,821 stars) compared to alternatives, but core functionality is still unstable as none of the automated tests passed.
